name: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme (PM-YASASVI)
providerName: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India
benefits: ₹75,000/year (Class 9-10) and ₹1,25,000/year (Class 11-12) covering school fees and hostel costs
description: PM-YASASVI is a flagship national scholarship program designed to support meritorious students from Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), and De-Notified Nomadic Tribes (DNT) studying in designated top-class schools across India.
eligibilityText: OBC/EBC/DNT candidates studying in Class 9 or 11 in recognized schools with annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakhs and minimum 60% in previous grade.

name: Centrally Sponsored Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
hindiName: अनुसूचित जाति के छात्रों के लिए पोस्ट मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
providerName: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: 100% compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursed + monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500/year
description: Comprehensive financial support provided to Scheduled Caste students post-matriculation to complete higher education in accredited colleges, universities, and polytechnics.
eligibilityText: SC category students enrolled in recognized post-matric/post-secondary courses. Total parental/guardian income must not exceed ₹2.5 Lakhs per annum.

name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship for Minority Girls
hindiName: बेगम हज़रत महल राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति (अल्पसंख्यक छात्राएं)
providerName: Maulana Azad Education Foundation, Ministry of Minority Affairs
benefits: ₹5,000 for Class 9-10; ₹6,000 for Class 11-12 towards educational expenses
description: Empowering girl students belonging to notified national minorities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, and Parsis) to continue secondary and higher secondary schooling without dropping out.
eligibilityText: Only girl students belonging to notified minority communities studying in Class 9th to 12th with min 50% marks and family income under ₹2.0 Lakhs.
documentsRequired: Marksheet of previous class signed by Principal

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
providerName: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study towards college fee, computer, books & equipment purchase
description: Aimed at advancing girls in STEM and technical fields. Grants 10,000 scholarships annually to female students admitted to the first year of AICTE-approved degree or diploma programs.
eligibilityText: Female candidate admitted to 1st year or 2nd year (via lateral entry) of AICTE approved technical degree/diploma. Maximum 2 girls per family. Family income <= ₹8.0 Lakhs.
documentsRequired: Annual Family Income Certificate (Issued by Tahsildar)
Admission Letter to AICTE Approved College

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students
providerName: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum towards fees, assistive devices, and educational expenses
description: Encouraging specially-abled students with 40% or more disability to pursue technical education in AICTE-recognized engineering colleges and polytechnics.
eligibilityText: Specially-abled students with disability not less than 40% admitted to 1st year AICTE degree or diploma. Family income up to ₹8.0 Lakhs per annum.

name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for North Eastern Region
hindiName: ईशान उदय विशेष छात्रवृत्ति योजना (पूर्वोत्तर क्षेत्र)
providerName: University Grants Commission (UGC)
benefits: ₹5,400/month for General Degree and ₹7,800/month for Technical/Medical/Professional courses
description: Administered by UGC to enhance the Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) of students from the eight North Eastern states (Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura) in higher education.
eligibilityText: Students with domicile of North Eastern Region who passed Class 12 and enrolled in 1st year undergraduate degree in recognized Universities/Colleges. Income <= ₹4.5 Lakhs.
documentsRequired: Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC) / Domicile of NER State

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
hindiName: कॉलेज और विश्वविद्यालय के छात्रों के लिए केंद्रीय क्षेत्र छात्रवृत्ति योजना
providerName: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
benefits: ₹12,000/year at graduation level for first 3 years and ₹20,000/year at post-graduation level
description: Scholarship awarded to meritorious students who scored above 80th percentile in their respective State Higher Secondary Board examinations and are pursuing regular degree courses.
eligibilityText: Top 20th percentile scorers in Class 12 State/CBSE/ICSE boards enrolled in regular degree programs with parental income up to ₹4.5 Lakhs.

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
hindiName: उच्च शिक्षा के लिए इंस्पायर छात्रवृत्ति (डीएसटी)
providerName: Department of Science and Technology (DST)
benefits: ₹80,000 per year (₹60,000 cash grant + ₹20,000 mandatory summer research mentorship)
description: Designed by DST to attract top young talent to study Natural and Basic Sciences (B.Sc., B.S., Int. M.Sc.) at the university level and pursue career paths in scientific research.
eligibilityText: Top 1% in Class 12 Board examinations OR rank within top 10,000 in JEE/NEET who are enrolled in B.Sc./B.S./Int. M.Sc. in Natural & Basic Sciences. No income limit.
documentsRequired: INSPIRE Eligibility Note / Board Rank Certificate
Endorsement Certificate signed by Head of College/Institute
State Bank of India (SBI) Account Passbook

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (EBC)
hindiName: राजर्षि छत्रपति शाहू महाराज शिक्षण शुल्क शिष्यवृत्ती योजना (महाडीबीटी)
providerName: Directorate of Higher & Technical Education, Govt. of Maharashtra
benefits: 50% Tuition Fee & 50% Exam Fee reimbursement in recognized degree and professional colleges
description: Maharashtra's premier scheme to ease higher education costs for economically backward class students taking admissions through CAP rounds in engineering, medicine, pharmacy, law, and arts/commerce.
eligibilityText: Maharashtra domicile candidate admitted through CAP (Centralized Admission Process) with family income <= ₹8.0 Lakhs. Maximum 2 beneficiaries from one family.
documentsRequired: Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar (Valid for current FY)

name: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojna (Hostel Allowance)
hindiName: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख वसतिगृह निर्वाह भत्ता योजना (महाराष्ट्र)
providerName: Govt. of Maharashtra
benefits: ₹30,000/year for Mega Cities (Mumbai/Pune/Nagpur) and ₹20,000/year for other districts
description: Hostel and subsistence maintenance allowance for children of registered marginal farmers, agricultural laborers, and general EBC students living away from native village.
eligibilityText: Maharashtra domicile student pursuing technical/professional degrees residing in college hostel or private rental room. Family income up to ₹8 Lakhs.
documentsRequired: Alpabhudharak / Land Record 7/12 extract or Registered Agriculture Laborer Certificate

name: UP Dashmottar Scholarship and Fee Reimbursement Scheme
hindiName: यूपी दशमोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति एवं शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति योजना
providerName: Social Welfare Department, Govt. of Uttar Pradesh
benefits: Full non-refundable fee reimbursement (up to ₹50,000+) + monthly allowance up to ₹1,200/month
description: Comprehensive scholarship and fee refund scheme for post-matric and post-intermediate students enrolled in universities, colleges, and polytechnics across Uttar Pradesh.
eligibilityText: Uttar Pradesh domicile studying in class 11th, 12th, or college degree in UP. Annual family income <= ₹2.0 Lakhs (General/OBC/Minority) or <= ₹2.5 Lakhs (SC/ST).
documentsRequired: Aadhaar Card (Linked with Mobile and Bank)
College Admission Slip & Current Fee Receipt

name: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Post-Matric Grant
providerName: Social Welfare & Backward Classes Welfare Dept, Govt. of Karnataka
benefits: Tuition fee waiver credited directly to college + monthly maintenance credited to student via DBT
description: Unified Karnataka scholarship portal for students belonging to SC, ST, OBC, and EWS categories pursuing higher education in recognized state institutions.
eligibilityText: Karnataka domicile student with valid Kutumba ID and SATS/Student ID. Family income <= ₹2.5L for SC/ST or <= ₹1.0L to ₹2.5L for Category 1/2A/3A/3B.
documentsRequired: Karnataka RD Caste & Income Certificate Number

name: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship (SVMCM)
providerName: Higher Education Department, Govt. of West Bengal
benefits: ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month (₹12,000 to ₹60,000 annually) depending on level of study
description: Prestigious assistance program by Govt. of West Bengal assisting meritorious students from economically weaker sections pursuing higher secondary, UG, PG, and engineering/medical studies.
eligibilityText: West Bengal domicile with minimum 60% aggregate marks in Madhyamik (10th) or Higher Secondary (12th) examination. Family income <= ₹2.5 Lakhs per year.
documentsRequired: Income Certificate from BDO / SDO / Joint BDO
WB Domicile Certificate (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Ration Card)
First Page of Bank Passbook (IFSC & A/C clearly visible)

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa (K2 Annual One-Time Grant)
providerName: Department of Women Development & Social Welfare, Govt. of West Bengal
benefits: One-time financial grant of ₹25,000 deposited directly into girl's bank account
description: UN Public Service Award-winning conditional cash transfer scheme empowering adolescent girls to delay early marriage and pursue higher secondary or college education.
eligibilityText: Unmarried female student residing in West Bengal aged between 18 and 19 years, actively enrolled in a recognized educational or vocational institution. No income barrier.
documentsRequired: Age Proof / Birth Certificate or Madhyamik Admit Card
Unmarried Declaration Form signed by Parents

name: SBI Asha Scholarship Program 2026
providerName: SBI Foundation
benefits: ₹15,000 for School students; ₹50,000 for Undergraduates; up to ₹7.5 Lakhs for premier IIT/IIM scholars
description: Flagship CSR initiative of State Bank of India's CSR arm to support low-income meritorious students across pan-India schools and premier universities with non-repayable grants.
eligibilityText: Open to pan-India students studying in Class 9-12 or enrolled in UG/PG courses. Minimum 75% marks in previous academic year. Annual family income <= ₹3 Lakhs.
documentsRequired: Government-issued identity proof (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID)
Current year admission proof (Fee receipt / Admission letter / ID Card)
Income Proof (Form 16 / Salary Slips / Income Certificate from Tahsildar)

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
providerName: Reliance Foundation
benefits: Up to ₹2,00,000 over the duration of the undergraduate degree + leadership & alumni development network
description: Supports 5,000 undergraduate students each year from all disciplines. Selection combines household income eligibility, Class 12 performance, and an online aptitude assessment.
eligibilityText: Indian citizen resident enrolled in 1st year full-time regular undergraduate degree. Minimum 60% in Class 12. Household income up to ₹15 Lakhs (preference given to <= ₹2.5L).
documentsRequired: Bonafide Student Certificate from College / University
Family Income Proof (ITR / Salary Certificate / Govt Income Certificate)

name: HDFC Bank Parivartan's Educational Crisis Scholarship Support (ECSS)
providerName: HDFC Bank Ltd.
benefits: Up to ₹35,000 for school students and up to ₹75,000 for UG/PG/Professional students
description: Aimed at children facing sudden personal or financial crises (loss of earning parent, terminal illness, severe job loss) to prevent education discontinuation.
eligibilityText: Students from Class 1 to Post-Graduation facing economic crisis. Min 55% marks in previous qualifying exam. Annual family income <= ₹2.5 Lakhs.
documentsRequired: Government Photo ID (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Driving License)
Current Year Admission Proof (Fee Receipt / Identity Card)
Proof of Crisis (Death Certificate / Medical Documents / Termination Letter)
Bank Account details of applicant or guardian

name: Kotak Kanya Scholarship for Meritorious Girls
providerName: Kotak Education Foundation
benefits: ₹1,50,000 per year until completion of professional degree (Engineering, MBBS, Architecture, Design, LLB)
description: Financial aid and mentorship to meritorious girl students from underprivileged backgrounds who have secured admission to 1st year professional degree programs at recognized institutes.
eligibilityText: Female candidate who scored >= 75% in Class 12 board and secured admission to first year of professional degree (Engineering, MBBS, Architecture, Law). Income <= ₹6.0L.
documentsRequired: Entrance Exam Scorecard (JEE / NEET / CLAT / State CET)
Income Certificate / ITR / Form 16 of parents

name: Tata Trust Medical and Healthcare Higher Education Grant
hindiName: टाटा ट्रस्ट मेडिकल एवं स्वास्थ्य सेवा उच्च शिक्षा अनुदान
providerName: Tata Trusts
benefits: 30% to 75% of total tuition fee waiver reimbursed directly to the educational institution
description: Need-cum-merit educational grants from Tata Trusts for students pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate studies in Medicine (MBBS/BDS/BAMS), Nursing, Pharmacy, and Allied Health Sciences in India.
eligibilityText: Students enrolled in recognized Medical/Dental/Nursing/Healthcare degree programs in India. Family annual income must not exceed ₹5 Lakhs.
documentsRequired: College Fee Structure letter on official letterhead

name: Aditya Birla Capital Scholarship Program
providerName: Aditya Birla Capital Foundation
benefits: Up to ₹18,000 for school students and up to ₹60,000 for college / professional students
description: An initiative to provide continuous academic support to students across schools and universities whose families have experienced financial adversity.
eligibilityText: Students enrolled in Class 9 to graduation in recognized Indian institutions. Min 60% in previous exam. Annual family income <= ₹6 Lakhs.
documentsRequired: Income Proof (Govt. Certificate / Salary Slip / Form 16)
Bank Account details of applicant / parent

name: L'Oréal India For Young Women In Science Scholarship
hindiName: लॉरियल इंडिया यंग वुमन इन साइंस छात्रवृत्ति
providerName: L'Oréal India
benefits: ₹2,50,000 allocated over the duration of graduation degree (Science / Engineering / Medicine / Biotechnology)
description: A prestigious, selective nationwide grant awarded to talented young women pursuing undergraduate degrees in Pure Science, Applied Science, Engineering, or Medicine.
eligibilityText: Female candidates who passed Class 12 with minimum 85% in PCB / PCM / PCMB and enrolled in graduation in scientific disciplines. Family income <= ₹6.0 Lakhs.
documentsRequired: Class 10 and 12 Marksheet with >= 85% in Science stream
College Admission Letter and Fee Receipt

name: Kerala Suvarna Jubilee Merit Scholarship
providerName: Department of Collegiate Education, Govt. of Kerala
benefits: ₹10,000 per year for undergraduate and postgraduate courses
description: Awarded to first-year students of UG and PG courses in Govt. or Aided Arts and Science colleges in Kerala who belong to BPL (Below Poverty Line) households.
eligibilityText: Kerala domicile studying 1st year regular UG or PG in Kerala Govt./Aided Arts and Science colleges. Must belong to BPL family or family income <= ₹1.0 Lakh.
documentsRequired: BPL Ration Card (Yellow/Pink) or Income Certificate <= ₹1 Lakh

name: Rajasthan Chief Minister Higher Education Scholarship Scheme
hindiName: राजस्थान मुख्यमंत्री उच्च शिक्षा छात्रवृत्ति योजना
providerName: College Education Department, Govt. of Rajasthan
benefits: ₹5,000/year (₹500 per month for 10 months) for regular college students; ₹10,000 for PwD
description: Provided by Govt. of Rajasthan to meritorious candidates from families with income up to ₹2.5 Lakhs who secured 60%+ in Senior Secondary Board exams.
eligibilityText: Rajasthan domicile who secured min 60% in Rajasthan Board Class 12 and enrolled in 1st year regular degree program. Annual income <= ₹2.5 Lakhs.
documentsRequired: Jan Aadhaar Card / Domicile Certificate of Rajasthan
Student Bank Account linked to Jan Aadhaar

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
providerName: Department of School Education & Literacy, MoE
benefits: ₹12,000 per year (₹1,000 per month) from Class 9 to Class 12
description: Nationwide scholarship aimed at preventing students from economically weaker sections from dropping out after Class 8 and encouraging them to complete senior secondary school.
eligibilityText: Students studying in Class 8 in Govt./Local Body/Govt.-aided schools who qualify State NMMS examination with >= 55% marks. Parental income <= ₹3.5 Lakhs.
documentsRequired: NMMS State Selection Merit Roll Card

name: Santoor Women's Scholarship
providerName: Wipro Consumer Care and Wipro Cares
benefits: ₹24,000 per year till completion of the undergraduate course
description: Supports young women from underprivileged backgrounds in Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Telangana, and Chhattisgarh to pursue higher education after Class 12.
eligibilityText: Female candidates who passed Class 10 from local Govt. school and Class 12 from Govt./inter college, enrolled in 1st year full-time recognized degree course.
documentsRequired: Class 10 and 12 passing certificates from Government school/college
Student Bank Passbook in nationalized bank

providerName: North Eastern Council Secretariat, Ministry of DoNER
benefits: ₹20,000 to ₹30,000 per year for Diploma/UG/PG and Professional courses
description: Financial assistance to students of the North Eastern States undergoing studies in higher professional courses (M.Tech, B.Tech, MBBS, Agriculture, MBA, etc.) in premier institutes in India.
eligibilityText: Permanent resident of any of the 8 NER states enrolled in technical/professional courses. Minimum 60% in previous exam. Family income <= ₹8.0 Lakhs.
